entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 190 aa soluble protein; predicted molecular mass 21.10 kDa and pI 5.18.
Contains Ham1p_like Pfam domain PF01725.22 across residues 3–186.
Has strong homology to curated dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases: up to 66% identity over 98.9% query coverage, E-value 1.04e-87.
Function is supported at moderate homology level rather than by a direct experimentally characterized query accession.

entities.name: dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: Curated homologs are annotated as EC 3.6.1.66 and act as nucleotide-pool sanitizing pyrophosphatases.
Curated homologs bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit and are annotated as homodimers.
Preferred substrates are noncanonical purine nucleotides XTP, dITP, and ITP.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis
observations: XTP + H2O = XMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28610.
The reaction is a candidate activity inferred from highly similar curated homologs.

entities.name: dITP hydrolysis
observations: dITP + H2O = dIMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28342.
The reaction is a candidate activity inferred from highly similar curated homologs.

entities.name: ITP hydrolysis
observations: ITP + H2O = IMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:29399.
The reaction is a candidate activity inferred from highly similar curated homologs.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Curated dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase homologs bind Mg2+, one ion per subunit.
